title: AI authorship
description: AI share of committed code, agent token spend and gitai-service ingest health, from gitai-service's OTLP counters. Aggregates only: no prompts, transcripts or commit text reach Grafana. For one commit, PR or session, use the gitai-service read API (the gitai-why agent skill).

panels.title: AI share of added lines
panels.description: AI-written added lines over all added lines in committed code, for the selected range. Counts include each counter series' first sample (a new author, model or repo, or the first event after a restart), which a plain increase() drops; increase() still extrapolates slightly.

targets.expr: sum(((increase(gitai_lines_total{service_name="gitai-service", deployment_environment="$deployment_environment", repo=~"$repo", author=~"$author", tool=~"$tool", kind="ai"}[$__range]) + panels.title: Commits per day by repo
panels.description: Committed events per day. Commits made before git-ai was installed, or with its daemon down, are missing here; compare with the repo's own commit count to spot machines without hooks. Per-commit attribution (with or without AI lines) is not in the counters; use the read API. Counts include each counter series' first sample (a new author, model or repo, or the first event after a restart), which a plain increase() drops; increase() still extrapolates slightly.

targets.expr: sum by (repo) (((increase(gitai_commits_total{service_name="gitai-service", deployment_environment="$deployment_environment", repo=~"$repo", author=~"$author"}[$__interval]) + (min_over_time(gitai_commits_total{service_name="gitai-service", deployment_environment="$deployment_environment", repo=~"$repo", author=~"$author"}[$__interval]) unless gitai_commits_total{service_name="gitai-service", deployment_environment="$deployment_environment", repo=~"$repo", author=~"$author"} offset $__interval)) or increase(gitai_commits_total{service_name="gitai-service", deployment_environment="$deployment_environment", repo=~"$repo", author=~"$author"}[$__interval]) or (min_over_time(gitai_commits_total{service_name="gitai-service", deployment_environment="$deployment_environment", repo=~"$repo", author=~"$author"}[$__interval]) unless gitai_commits_total{service_name="gitai-service", deployment_environment="$deployment_environment", repo=~"$repo", author=~"$author"} offset $__interval)))

panels.title: Upload batches by endpoint and result
panels.description: Client upload requests per second. unauthorized means a revoked or unknown credential; invalid means a body the server could not decode.

panels.title: Events by type and result
panels.description: Metric events per second. dropped_repo and dropped_no_repo are events outside github.com/macro-inc/macro, dropped by the server.

panels.title: Redaction hits by rule
panels.description: Secrets masked by the server's redaction pass, per hour, by rule. A rising rule means clients are sending that kind of secret. Counts include each counter series' first sample (a new author, model or repo, or the first event after a restart), which a plain increase() drops; increase() still extrapolates slightly.

targets.expr: sum by (rule) (((increase(gitai_redaction_hits_total{service_name="gitai-service", deployment_environment="$deployment_environment"}[$__interval]) + (min_over_time(gitai_redaction_hits_total{service_name="gitai-service", deployment_environment="$deployment_environment"}[$__interval]) unless gitai_redaction_hits_total{service_name="gitai-service", deployment_environment="$deployment_environment"} offset $__interval)) or increase(gitai_redaction_hits_total{service_name="gitai-service", deployment_environment="$deployment_environment"}[$__interval]) or (min_over_time(gitai_redaction_hits_total{service_name="gitai-service", deployment_environment="$deployment_environment"}[$__interval]) unless gitai_redaction_hits_total{service_name="gitai-service", deployment_environment="$deployment_environment"} offset $__interval)))

panels.title: Upload batches by client version
panels.description: Accepted upload batches per second by git-ai client version. More than one version means some machines are not on the pinned release.
